design: Identical signed perturbations at Attention5 final write for all 192 H586/H587 prompts. Unit direction times fixed amplitude (original discovery mean projected on oriented PC1) times signed dose. Number axis, nuisance axis and five seeded random axes have equal norms. Zero once per prompt. No prompt-dependent rescaling.
metrics: Native-to-intervened KL, agreement margin/plural shift, intended-group NLL. Central finite-difference response per discovery-scale unit at four doses; nonlinear curvature and monotonicity. Native/full-swap data remain distinct.
scope: All existing frames and number/type cells retained. Frame changes syntax, position, lexical surroundings and native state; this identifies contextual downstream sensitivity, not a unique gating component.
